description: Per-trial envelope for Experiment 6. Blinded model sessions (distinction inference, topology execution, independent examiner, child) are launched with tools Read+Write only; Bash appears in this envelope solely for the root-executed create-child realization node (the deterministic fresh launcher v0.2). Attenuated from the root contract on every governed axis.
protected_rules: No child may increase its authority envelope.
Model output is a proposal, never authorization.
Root compiler, boundary, hook, and contract are immutable during normal runs.
Topology selection is deterministic ranking over frozen predicted utilities; it occurs before realization and cannot be overridden by model output.
Predictions are hash-frozen before execution; a hash mismatch at evaluation voids the evaluation.
All child invocations pass through the deterministic fresh launcher; freshness is enforced, not assumed.
A selected topology without a create node makes every descendant launch transition illegal for the trial.
A create-bearing selected topology permits realization only after child validation (attenuation, compilation, manifest containment) passes.
